title: New Season of Art in the Park
paragraphs: Guild of Harwich Artists President Chris Banks

Art in The Park season kicks off Monday, July 1, 2019. Members of The Guild of Harwich Artists exhibit and sell original artwork in Harwich Port’s Doane Park in what has become a highlight event of the summer. Art in the Park will be held every Monday from 10am to 4pm through August 26th. Rain days are the following Wednesdays at the same location.

Each Monday, Guild participants exhibit work in a wide range of artistic styles and mediums including pastel drawings, watercolor, and oil paintings. Artists are thrilled to engage with the public about their work. Rain dates on Wednesdays.
Ample public parking available in adjacent Post Office Square host to the Harwich Port Doane Park is an easy walk from Harwich Port center including the Guild’s Art Gallery at 551 Route 28.

Art in The Park season kicks off Monday, July 1, 2019. Members of The Guild of Harwich Artists exhibit and sell original artwork in Harwich Port’s Doane Park in what has become a highlight event of the summer.  Art in the Park will be held every Monday from 10am to 4pm through August 26th.  Rain days are the following Wednesdays at the same location.

Each Monday, Guild participants exhibit work in a wide range of artistic styles and mediums including pastel drawings, watercolor, and oil paintings. Artists are thrilled to engage with the public about their work. Rain dates on Wednesdays.

Ample public parking available in adjacent Post Office Square host to the Harwich Port Doane Park is an easy walk from Harwich Port center including the Guild’s Art Gallery at 551 Route 28.
